label: Ик / Чик
description: A 10-sentence card for the diminutive suffix -ик/-чик.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: домик from дом. The suffix -ик turns дом 'house' into домик 'little house', adding smallness and a cosy, affectionate tone to the building.
Strategic focus: столик from стол. The suffix -ик shrinks стол 'table' into столик 'little table', marking a small or low piece of furniture with a friendly note.
Strategic focus: contrast дом and домик. The plain дом names a full-size house, while домик with -ик signals a small, modest one; the pair shows the suffix adding smallness directly.
Strategic focus: садик from сад. The suffix -ик makes сад 'garden' into садик 'little garden', conveying a small plot and a warm, homely feeling.
Strategic focus: ключик from ключ. The suffix -ик turns ключ 'key' into ключик 'little key', stressing the small size of the object affectionately.
Strategic focus: диванчик from диван. The suffix -чик shrinks диван 'sofa' into диванчик 'little sofa', adding smallness and a soft, cosy nuance.
Strategic focus: стаканчик from стакан. The suffix -чик turns стакан 'glass' into стаканчик 'little glass', marking a small portion with a casual, friendly tone.
Strategic focus: ключик from ключ. Again -ик gives ключик 'little key' a sense of smallness and care, here for an everyday household object.
Strategic focus: домик from дом. The suffix -ик paired with 'крошечный' doubles the sense of smallness, presenting дом 'house' as a tiny, beloved cottage.
Strategic focus: садик from сад. The suffix -ик turns сад 'garden' into садик 'little garden', expressing both modest size and the owner's fondness for it.
